test_item:
KeyInstall feature shall guarantee that keys cannot be overwritten by any process once keys installation was successful.
(keys already installed; a new installation is not started)
pre:
1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
2. Keys have been successfully installed on the DUT
3. A USB drive containing valid platform keys has been inserted into the HU USB port
proc:
1. Read the installation state file in the secure partition
$ adb shell od -t x1 /mnt/vendor/oemkeys/installstate
2. Confirm the content of /mnt/vendor/oemkeys on the DUT
$ adb shell ls -l /mnt/vendor/oemkeys
er:
1. The adb shell od -t x1 /mnt/vendor/oemkeys/installstate output shows the installstate value 2
2. The adb shell ls -l /mnt/vendor/oemkeys output lists the originally stored key material
design: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
author: PeiPYHsu
remarks:
